meta.note: Sunday, August 16, 2026 is not a regular U.S. equity session. Current analysis is based on the August 14 close and after-hours snapshot.
meta.revision_note: The three-consecutive-up-closes study requires three complete positive close-to-close returns; initial incomplete rolling windows are excluded.

large_up.name: Large up day ≥ +8%
large_up.interpretation: Strong one-day momentum was usually followed by cooling in this 50-session sample.

large_down.name: Large down day ≤ −8%
large_down.interpretation: Large selloffs often produced mean-reversion rebounds in this sample.

three_up.name: 3 consecutive up closes
three_up.interpretation: The two valid three-rising-close sequences in this 50-session sample were followed by a next-day pullback; the sample is too small for a reliable forecast.

momentum5.name: 5-session return > +10%
momentum5.interpretation: Extended five-session momentum often cooled over the next few sessions.

gap_up.name: Gap up ≥ +3%
gap_up.interpretation: Gap-up sessions had weak next-day continuation on average.

weak_close.name: Close in bottom 20% + RVOL > 1
weak_close.interpretation: Weak closes on active volume often rebounded, but the sample was very small.

tomorrow.directional_read: Neutral-to-bullish recovery with short-term overhead supply

scenario_weights.name: Range / consolidation
scenario_weights.path: Two-sided trade; buyers hold the recovery but sellers continue defending the upper zone.

tomorrow.warning: Weights are analyst-judgment scenario weights, not calibrated probabilities or a recommendation.

catalysts.title: Horizon 1 delivered to and accepted by Microsoft; NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status achieved
catalysts.detail: The first of four 50MW deployments under the five-year $9.7bn Microsoft cloud-services contract was delivered. The release also cited 480MW gross AI Cloud capacity targeted for 2026 and 1.2GW for 2027.

catalysts.title: FY26 results scheduled for August 27, 2026
catalysts.detail: The upcoming report can increase event risk and implied expectations even before the release.

catalysts.title: Mirantis acquisition completed
catalysts.detail: IREN said the acquisition strengthens software, orchestration, monitoring and customer support; consideration included approximately 12.6m shares plus other consideration.

catalysts.title: New AI Cloud contracts and higher ARR target
catalysts.detail: IREN announced $2.8bn of new contracts and raised its year-end 2026 AI Cloud ARR target to more than $4bn, with about 85% under contract.

risks.title: Execution and valuation expectations
risks.detail: The stock is reacting to large future-capacity and revenue targets; delays, costs or utilization below expectations can reprice the shares quickly.

risks.title: Capital intensity and dilution
risks.detail: IREN disclosed a $6bn at-the-market facility and substantial share issuance in 2026; financing growth can dilute existing holders.

risks.title: Debt and purchase commitments
risks.detail: The company has issued large convertible-note financings and disclosed multi-billion-dollar GPU purchase commitments.

risks.title: High volatility
risks.detail: The 14-session ATR is about $4.01, roughly 9.1% of the current close; gaps and wide intraday ranges are normal in the recent sample.
